description: Provision an Azure Network PublicIPAddress via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the network.azure.com/v1api20240301 PublicIPAddress spec.

azureName.description:
AzureName: The name of the resource in Azure. This is often the same as the name of the resource in Kubernetes but it
doesn't have to be.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.
credentialFrom.title: Azure credential Secret

ddosSettings.description: DdosSettings: The DDoS protection custom policy associated with the public IP address.

ddosProtectionPlan.description: DdosProtectionPlan: The DDoS protection plan associated with the public IP. Can only be set if ProtectionMode is Enabled

armId.description:
ARMID is a string of the form /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}.
The /resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName} bit is optional as some resources are scoped at the subscription level
ARMID is mutually exclusive with Group, Kind, Namespace and Name.

group.description: Group is the Kubernetes group of the resource.

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes kind of the resource.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes name of the resource.

protectionMode.description: ProtectionMode: The DDoS protection mode of the public IP

deleteOption.description: DeleteOption: Specify what happens to the public IP address when the VM using it is deleted

dnsSettings.description: DnsSettings: The FQDN of the DNS record associated with the public IP address.

domainNameLabel.description:
DomainNameLabel: The domain name label. The concatenation of the domain name label and the regionalized DNS zone make up
the fully qualified domain name associated with the public IP address. If a domain name label is specified, an A DNS
record is created for the public IP in the Microsoft Azure DNS system.

domainNameLabelScope.description:
DomainNameLabelScope: The domain name label scope. If a domain name label and a domain name label scope are specified,
an A DNS record is created for the public IP in the Microsoft Azure DNS system with a hashed value includes in FQDN.

fqdn.description:
Fqdn: The Fully Qualified Domain Name of the A DNS record associated with the public IP. This is the concatenation of
the domainNameLabel and the regionalized DNS zone.

reverseFqdn.description:
ReverseFqdn: The reverse FQDN. A user-visible, fully qualified domain name that resolves to this public IP address. If
the reverseFqdn is specified, then a PTR DNS record is created pointing from the IP address in the in-addr.arpa domain
to the reverse FQDN.

extendedLocation.description: ExtendedLocation: The extended location of the public ip address.

name.description: Name: The name of the extended location.

type.description: Type: The type of the extended location.

idleTimeoutInMinutes.description: IdleTimeoutInMinutes: The idle timeout of the public IP address.

ipAddress.description: IpAddress: The IP address associated with the public IP address resource.

ipTags.description: IpTags: The list of tags associated with the public IP address.

items.description: Contains the IpTag associated with the object.

ipTagType.description: IpTagType: The IP tag type. Example: FirstPartyUsage.

tag.description: Tag: The value of the IP tag associated with the public IP. Example: SQL.

linkedPublicIPAddress.description: LinkedPublicIPAddress: The linked public IP address of the public IP address resource.

configMapExpressions.description: ConfigMapExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic ConfigMaps (created with CEL expressions).

items.description:
DestinationExpression is a CEL expression and a destination to store the result in. The destination may
be a secret or a configmap. The value of the expression is stored at the specified location in
the destination.

annotations.description: Annotations is an optional set of annotations to apply to the destination resource.

key.description:
Key is the key in the ConfigMap or Secret being written to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a string
this is required to identify what key to write to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a map[string]string
Key must not be set, instead the keys written will be determined dynamically based on the keys of the resulting
map[string]string.
